prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW COLOURED MANGA CHARACTER PORTRAIT of Tinatin, designed as the style anchor for a matching set of21 character medallions for a medieval Georgian poem board game.
Input1 is her original painted portrait: use ONLY for identity, dark wavy hair, adult age, complexion, crown and restrained plum/gold color cues. Input2 is the approved manga coronation scene: use its Tinatin character design, expressive2D manga face, bold ink contours, simplified clothing, large black shapes and clear dramatic character acting. Do NOT copy painted rendering or all-over brocade fromInput1.
NEW FORMAT: square canvas, ideally1536x1536. Exactly one young adult queen, head, shoulders and upper chest, three-quarter pose, open confident expression. A complete circular medallion centered on canvas, diameter94% ofcanvas; simple narrow antique-gold rim and one thin dark outline. All hair, crown and shoulders lie inside circle. Insidebackground is flat muted petrol-teal, no scenery or patterns. Outsidecircle is genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha.
STYLE/COLOR: organic Japanese historical-adventure manga drawing, clearly stylized adult face and expressive eyes, designed dark hair locks, clean bold black ink, simple broad folds and two-tone CEL SHADING. Rich but restrained color: warm natural olive skin, dark chestnut hair, muted plum cloak/robe, cream collar, small antique-gold crown/clasps/earrings. Moderate color saturation, readable jewel tones, no neon. Distinct flat color shapes, no soft painted realism, no engraved dense hatching or ornamental texture. Crown fullyvisible, modest court clothing. No Japanese kimono or modern accessories.
NO TEXT, LETTERS, NUMBERS, NAME LABELS, SPEECH BUBBLES, SOUND EFFECTS, BANNERS, SCROLLS, LOGOS OR WATERMARKS. Exactly one circular portrait on transparent canvas, not a page or collage.
processing: Copied unchanged; native pixels and alpha preserved

visual_review.review: Inspected individually or at final cast contact sheet; coloured manga ink/cel shading, recognizable character identity and age, single complete medallion, no lettering, intact background.
